name: MoYu WeiLong WR M 3x3 V10 (Magnetic, MagLev, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated)

Building on the legendary WeiLong series, the V10 is equipped with MagLev technology, a powerful 20-magnet ball-core for increased stability, and a sleek UV Coated surface for enhanced grip.
features: Corner-to-core magnets for a better, more controllable turning feel
